docs.description: Complete design docs: epic, architecture, schema (54 tables), engines (13), seeds, API, implementation plan. Read in doc order 00-08, then SOTA-00 through SOTA-09.

build.description: Primary development agent. Full tool access for implementing features, writing code, running tests, and shipping.

plan.description: Planning and analysis agent. Read-only — cannot edit files or run commands. Use for architecture review, design decisions, and implementation planning.

test.description: Testing specialist. Writes unit, integration, and E2E tests. Runs test suites, analyzes coverage, fixes flaky tests. Use for all testing tasks.

review.description: Code review agent. Analyzes code for quality, bugs, security, and performance. Read-only — reports findings without making changes.

db.description: Database and Prisma specialist. Handles schema changes, migrations, seed files, query optimization, and database debugging.

debug.description: Debugging specialist. Investigates bugs using logs, traces, grep, and read tools. Reports root cause and fix recommendations.

migrate.template: Run the Prisma migration: bunx prisma migrate dev --name $ARGUMENTS

seed.template: Run database seeding: bun run seed

check.template: Run the full quality check pipeline: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test

coverage.template: Run tests with coverage: bun test --coverage

review.template: Review the current git diff for code quality, bugs, and security issues. Focus on: type safety, error handling, and edge cases.

ship.template: Run the full ship pipeline: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test && echo 'All checks passed - ready to ship.'

devops.description: Run the agentic DevOps orchestrator loop to autonomously implement atomic units
devops.template: Load the devops skill and run the agentic DevOps orchestrator loop: read docs/atomic/01-tracker.md, then repeatedly `bun run devops select` to get the next unit, implement it per its atomic file, run `bun run devops gate`, and on pass run `bun run devops mark <id> done` + commit. Continue until all units are done or only blocked units remain. Never pause to ask.
